tools.name: search_grants
tools.description: Use this when someone wants funding for a US small business or organization — grants, loans, or tax credits — including indirect questions about paying for equipment, hiring, a storefront, exporting, or startup costs (e.g. "grants for my bakery in Ohio", "how can I pay for a new truck for my landsca

tools.name: check_eligibility
tools.description: Use this when the user asks whether they qualify for a specific US funding program (by name or from earlier results), or shares business details after a search. Checks base requirements — state, organization type, ownership, size, industry — and returns meets / does not meet / need to know for each,

tools.name: get_grant
tools.description: Use this when the user asks for details about one specific US funding program — what it funds, how much, who it's for, deadline and status, how long applying takes. Returns public program facts and a link to the program page. For "do I qualify" use check_eligibility instead. Not for non-US programs
